edition.notes: The Rosenbaum and Silbermann edition prints a vocalized Hebrew Rashi with a facing English translation and notes. Both are in the public domain. The English expands Rashi's abbreviations and supplies bracketed clarifications; a quotation of it is a quotation of the translators as well as of Rashi. Catalog-level record created 2026-07-26. No exact artifact has been registered; publications consulting a digital delivery of this edition record their own access route and limits locally.
edition.title: Pentateuch with Targum Onkelos, Haphtaroth and Rashi's Commentary, translated and annotated by M. Rosenbaum and A. M. Silbermann

work.author: Solomon ben Isaac of Troyes (Rashi)
work.description: Rashi's commentary on the Pentateuch, written in the late eleventh century and the most widely printed Jewish commentary on the Torah. Rashi habitually distinguishes the plain sense of a verse from its midrashic sense and prints them in that order; a reader who takes a midrashic sense reported by Rashi as his own plain-sense judgment has misread him. A locus is BookToken.chapter.verse.
work.title: Perush Rashi al ha-Torah
